blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City residents may soon need only one valid government-issued identification card when transacting with city offices under a proposed measure seeking to simplify identification requirements. Councilor Harold Kendrick Go is urging all Cebu City Government departments and offices, as well as private establishments, to accept a single valid government-issued ID, […]...
